items.title: Retail investors aren't entirely giving up on AI trade, but they appear more cautious
items.summary: Retail investors aren't giving up on the artificial intelligence trade. But they are getting selective and adding downside protection as markets head into the fall.

items.title: Goldman studied where AI is squeezing labor markets. Here's what it found
items.summary: Artificial intelligence is starting to weigh on labor market across major developed economies, with effects varying across industries and seniority levels, according to Goldman Sachs.

items.title: What Chinese liquor maker Moutai's slump says about the country's economy

items.title: Kalshi seeks to launch ‘perps’ on equity indexes as it moves in on traditional exchanges' turf
items.summary: Prediction market platform Kalshi in a regulatory filing on Tuesday revealed it is seeking to launch perpetual futures tied to equity indexes.

items.title: Lakers governor Jeanie Buss says siblings cannot sell family’s stake to Bob Iger, Joshua Kushner
items.summary: Los Angeles Lakers governor Jeanie Buss is opposing the potential sale of her family's stake in the NBA team, contradicting an earlier ESPN report about the family's decision to sell to Bob Iger and Joshua Kushner.
